HOLY SH*T!!

I sent my Dot screenshots of a passage from Nietzsche and asked what book it was from.

It identified the book AND the exact translation. Then I asked if it could turn the entire book into something I could read like an actual e-book.

It found the full public-domain text, built a swipeable reader with bookmarks, adjustable text and night mode, and made an EPUB I can open in Apple Books.

All from two screenshots and a conversation. This is fucking insane.

First, the tech difference: Sandbox vs. Background Plumbing.
ChatGPT Dots and Gemini Spark are always-on background agents. They tether directly to your personal workspace—hooking into 4,000+ app connectors, reading emails, monitoring notifications, and acting autonomously while you sleep.
Under UK GDPR, continuous background data ingestion + automated decision-making = instant regulatory alarm bells. 🚨
